Explore the live serverless WebAssembly apps below or click any demo card to inspect the interactive module and source code tabs.

title: scattyr: Generic Scatter Plots in R & Python
text:
scattyr is a unified framework providing modular, reactive generic scatter plot applications built with R (ggplot2 + bslib / shiny) and Python (plotnine + shiny / shinywidgets).






R / Shiny Scatter Plot
Python / plotnine Scatter Plot








Interactive Shinylive Demo: R Scatter App
Interactive Shinylive Demo: Python Scatter App


App Source: scatterPlotApp.R
App Source: scatter_plot_app.py


Core Function: scatter_ggplot()
Core Function: scatter_plotnine()


Open circle symbols (shape = 1), Dark2 palette, dynamic faceting
Open symbols (fill = "none", stroke = 1.5), plotnine grammar











Rscript -e 'source("scatterPlotApp.R"); scatterPlotApp()'



source("scatterPlotApp.R")
scatterPlotApp()







shiny run scatter_plot_app.py



from scatter_plot_app import app
app.run()

theme.R: Theme configuration functions (scattyr_theme(), scattyr_plot_theme()).
